As a final-year ENTC student with a CGPA of 8.2, you meet the academic and departmental eligibility requirements for several research grants [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3]. However, you can only apply for grants that currently have an **open** status [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2 General eligibility rules]. Additionally, note that a student may hold at most two research grants at the same time [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2 General eligibility rules].

Here are the research grants available to you:

| Grant Code | Title | Amount | Application Deadline |
|---|---|---|---|
| GR-IOT-07 | Smart Campus IoT Research Grant | ₹80,000 [SQL] | 20 Jan 2027 [SQL] |
| GR-5G-15 | 5G and Next-Gen Networks Fellowship | ₹1,10,000 [SQL] | 31 Jan 2027 [SQL] |
| GR-VLSI-09 | VLSI Design Research Fellowship | ₹1,20,000 [SQL] | 10 Feb 2027 [SQL] |
| GR-SUS-08 | Sustainability & Green Computing Grant | ₹70,000 [SQL] | 28 Feb 2027 [SQL] |
| GR-ENT-13 | Student Startup Seed Grant | ₹2,00,000 [SQL] | 01 Mar 2027 [SQL] |

### Closed Grants (Deadline Passed / No Longer Accepting Applications)
* **GR-HW-06** — Hardware Hackathon Seed Fund (₹30,000) [SQL] — Closed on 15 Dec 2026 [SQL]
* **GR-ROB-12** — Autonomous Robotics Research Grant (₹85,000) [SQL] — Closed on 31 Dec 2026 [SQL]
sql: SELECT grant_code, title, amount, application_open, application_deadline, status FROM grants WHERE grant_code = ANY(ARRAY['GR-ENT-13', 'GR-5G-15', 'GR-VLSI-09', 'GR-SUS-08', 'GR-HW-06', 'GR-IOT-07', 'GR-ROB-12']) ORDER BY application_deadline
